name: PlayBigScreen
description: The apps that come with PlayBigScreen.

apps.name: PlayTheater
apps.subtitle: Your films, series, music and audiobooks
apps.description: Opens your PlayTheater server full screen, in its TV layout. Sign in once and Continue watching, plus what's new in your libraries, show up on the home screen; Search finds films and series on the server too.
apps.author: PlayBigScreen

apps.name: RomM
apps.subtitle: Your game library, played in the browser
apps.description: Browse the games on your RomM server by platform, with their covers, and play them with RomM's built-in emulator. Continue playing and recently added games show up on the home screen, and Search finds games too. Needs a RomM server.
apps.author: PlayBigScreen

apks.name: PlayTheater for Android
apks.subtitle: The PlayTheater app, with its own player
apks.description: The PlayTheater Android app: your PlayTheater server with the device's own video player, downloads for watching offline, and music and audiobooks that keep playing with the screen off. The PlayTheater launcher app opens the server's web app instead and needs nothing installed.
apks.author: PlayTheater
